svg.title: Required audit: commit business data and event together
svg.desc: Both business writes and audit.log(input, tx) use tx; a failed step makes the caller abort and roll back. Automatic HTTP capture reports failure without undoing completed business work. Record a rollback failure event after the original transaction finishes rolling back.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: Required audit: commit business data and event together
